verdict.comment: French Haven clicked with her Newmarket win but could still prove vulnerable to improvement from CAPTAIN CESS and Classic Cause.

comments.captaincess: Close third of nine at Bath (1m, good to firm; gelded since) on handicap/seasonal debut
comments.classiccause: 1m looks sure to suit and another step forward is likely if he proves effective on turf
comments.frenchhaven: Big change of tactics to come from last to win at Newmarket (1m) 16 days ago; back up 2lb
comments.kaleidoscopeeyes: Consistent in handicaps up to 7f on Tapeta for M Appleby; sold for 7,000gns one month ago
comments.payattention: 0-9; in the frame from off pace in 1m handicaps for new yard in his three races this term
comments.profitrockit: Blinkered for this reappearance (fifth start) and needs to take a step forward
comments.shesagoldigger: Handicapping will provide a much more suitable opening if she has any ability
comments.taketheboat: Won three handicaps this year on the Kempton AW (1m/7f); possible excuses last two outings
comments.yafaarr: No solid claims; gelded and cheekpieces; on a modest opening mark, he needs a market check
comments.zaraquelle: Faded in her two handicaps (9.4f/1m) and did not beat many of those rivals

races.raceComment: frenchhaven is marginally preferred with a score of 38.1%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and better suited by conditions and stronger recent form over kaleidoscopeeyes. Won 1 of last 3 starts. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: James Ferguson's filly BAY OF DREAMS has remained in good form since her Newcastle win in March and gets the vote.

comments.adversary: Went close over 7f on AW in April; up in trip in new headgear for turf debut; a possible
comments.aphroditesrock: Has struggled on both outings this year; headgear switched today
comments.bayofdreams: Placed twice since winning handicap debut in March, latterly in higher-grade C&D race
comments.beachboroughgirl: Well beaten on handicap debut; drops back from 1m2f with cheekpieces added here
comments.cleverjack: Went close on nursery debut (7f, AW) but reappeared with poor 1m run in April
comments.garibaldimemory: Unable to land a significant blow in three novice races; may fare better in handicaps
comments.genbu: Well beaten in first two handicaps, the latter over C&D; too risky
comments.glittercode: 0-10 and not progressing but ran well behind a big improver last month
comments.westgatewarrior: Improved form when fifth in 5f maiden on stable debut; hiked up in trip for first handicap

races.raceComment: bayofdreams is confidently preferred with a score of 43.2%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and stronger recent form and superior course form and more reliable profile over glittercode. Won 1 of last 3 starts. Going is a significant concern - yet to win on Good To Soft ground from 1 attempts. Key attributes include optimal distance and consistent performer, though unfavorable draw and regressive form need consideration.

races.drawBiasExplanation: Longer distance reduces impact of draw position

verdict.comment: Given the standard of form on offer in this field, it is not hard to turn to the Haggas-trained newcomer FOREVER PENYWERN.

comments.arcimboldo: 12-1, slowly away and always behind in maiden at Windsor (1m, good to firm) five weeks ago
comments.bullingtonbry: 25-1 at Newbury (7f, good) 16 days ago, always behind but he was badly hampered 2f out
comments.coulsea: Mid-division at Ayr; 18l last of 5 at York (1m) but he was severely up against it at 150-1
comments.dabhand: 26,000euros yearling; 11th foal; Coulsty half-brother to winners, some useful; late foal
comments.foreverpenywern: Closely related to 1m1f Group 2 winner; very much one to note from a top yard
comments.impresario: 50-1 for 7f novice at Newbury and did not show much, tailing off; blinkered this time
comments.maeva: 14-1 at Kempton (1m, AW) last October, beaten about 8l but some late headway and promise
comments.medwayqueen: 8,000gns yearling by Churchill; perhaps one for later
comments.onemorechrome: Second 2yo start was disappointing (6-1) but early days and he has a useful pedigree
comments.outlandish: Wolverhampton novice (8.6f, AW; 8-1) in March was modest form but stacks went wrong
comments.satyress: On pedigree she looks a longer-term prospect for longer trips; that was backed up by debut
comments.withoutburlington: One of the top form candidates after latest start; may improve again; 30,000gns sale since
comments.zaramara: Modest form when fourth of six at Yarmouth (7f) but tailed off in a C&D maiden 12 days ago

races.raceComment: satyress is marginally preferred with a score of 17.9%. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

races.drawBiasExplanation: Soft/heavy going typically favors higher draws on straight tracks

verdict.comment: The newcomers will need to be pretty streetwise to beat CHARLIE BOYO, who ran to a useful level when second on his debut.

comments.ambishio: Out of unraced half-sister to two 5f Group 1 winners and a 5f Group 3 winner; interesting
comments.ameeq: Showed his inexperience and some significant ability before fading into sixth on debut
comments.capitalization: £260,000 breeze-up 2yo; needs to be taken very seriously on debut
comments.chairmanfourtimes: £50,000 breeze-up 2yo; half-brother to a 7f 2yo winner; probably needs to be useful
comments.charlieboyo: Failed by only a neck to justify favouritism at Salisbury; sets a good standard
comments.flashrascal: First foal; dam 1m2f winner, half-sister to good sprinter Evens And Odds; market may guide
comments.roguesupremacy: £160,000 breeze-up buy; bred to be a very fast 2yo
comments.wildthoughts: Well beaten on both starts (5f/6f) and can't be recommended here

verdict.comment: Preference in a competitive race is for THE CRAFTY MOLE who went close at Haydock ten days ago. Expressionless won this last year.

comments.bulldogspirit: Won with authority in a six-runner race over C&D (good to firm) three weeks ago; up 5lb
comments.currumbin: Did well on AW for new yard over the winter but his last two outings prompt doubts
comments.expressionless: Won this last year; reappearance was promising and steadily run race was an excuse latest
comments.gallantlion: Well backed to win comfortably in this headgear at Chepstow (1m4f) on Friday; no penalty
comments.goldenflame: All three wins were 2021; twice 2nd on AW this year and creditable third at Ascot latest
comments.mandarb: 2-7 in France but well beaten in Britain in his 1m2f Flat handicap and two hurdle races
comments.moltensea: Weak in betting 16 days ago; presumably needed that run and suited by this longer trip
comments.rocknrollpinkie: Twice won well over C&D in 2024 and reappeared with a close third of six at Doncaster
comments.russianrumour: C&D winner; creditable reappearance behind Golden Flame at Ascot three weeks ago
comments.thecraftymole: Excelled last April-August at 1m6f; back-to-form second at Haydock (2m) ten days ago

races.raceComment: thecraftymole is marginally preferred with a score of 55.6%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions over bulldogspirit. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good To Soft) looks ideal with 3 wins from 7 starts in similar conditions. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Excellent course form of 5/15 at nottingham. Key attributes include optimal distance and positive comments, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Phone Tag and Diddy Man are second and third choices behind fellow last-time-out winner RISING FORCE.

comments.charencey: Off 99 days and a number of his stablemates have been shooting back to winning form
comments.cliffcake: Three backward steps since 6f AW win; old effectiveness over 1m was not evident on latest
comments.diddyman: 7f AW win this April latest; back up 7lb but still well treated if he returns to his peak
comments.dreampirate: It's pretty glaring that his three wins have all been on soft, latest over C&D in October
comments.drumstick: 0-10; last of 13 when back on turf at Newbury (1m, good) 16 days ago; now tries a hood
comments.havanaprince: Running well but it's possible that the forcing tactics on him are better suited to 7f
comments.intercessor: Left Newland/Insole stable; no tongue-tie or other headgear today, first time since 2021
comments.kracking: Forceful front-runner; won well at Brighton in April but well beaten both starts since
comments.phonetag: Back from 1m2f and hood removed when he won under William Pyle at Pontefract (1m, good)
comments.powerofzeus: Finished last on last four outings; off nearly three months and tries his first headgear
comments.risingforce: Solid sequence from last November onwards, winning at Yarmouth last time; highly respected
comments.siamfox: Won at Windsor (1m, good to firm) last June off 4lb higher; not disgraced on 2025 return
comments.sustained: Reappeared with a good front-running second over this trip on Wolverhampton AW 13 days ago

races.raceComment: havanaprince is marginally preferred with a score of 54.1%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions over risingforce. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good To Soft) looks ideal with 4 wins from 13 starts in similar conditions. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Excellent course form of 5/19 at nottingham. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Possible winners galore but MUSICAL TOUCH can regain the winning thread back at 6f. Crimson Sand heads the long list of dangers.

comments.aberamagold: On a reduced mark; not at his best the last twice but the return of headgear looks a plus
comments.ararat: Course win (7f) last year for another yard; well beaten in two runs for current stable
comments.cairngorm: Defied long absence to make winning stable debut in December; not progressed; headgear now
comments.crimsonsand: Good record on AW, including C&D; had wind op since solid third on Good Friday; contender
comments.farasilane: Handicapped to win but he's drawn widest on a rare run over 6f
comments.fiscalpolicy: Progressive sprinter; C&D winner who ties in with a few of these on recent runs; wide draw
comments.jesseluc: Six wins (three over C&D) this year; up in class but foolish to rule out further progress
comments.mesaafi: A neck behind Northcliff when second at Ascot latest; 3lb higher but on an upward curve
comments.monsieurbeaulieu: Below par on turf last time but did little wrong in a productive AW campaign beforehand
comments.monsieurkodi: C&D win in November came in a less-competitive event; needs to raise his game
comments.musicaltouch: Came up short in hat-trick bid at York in May but ran well;  the return to 6f is a plus
comments.northcliff: Came up short in his bid for a 4-timer at Newmarket latest; handicapper may have him now
comments.rebelpath: Two C&D wins over the winter & scored decisively at Newmarket latest; up 7lb but respected
comments.supremeking: His last two wins have come over 6f on Polytrack; good 2nd at Chester latest (7f); solid

races.raceComment: jesseluc is marginally preferred with a score of 60.0%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and superior course form and more progressive and more reliable profile over rebelpath. Won 4 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 4 wins from 10 starts in similar conditions. Excellent course form of 6/20 at chelmsford. Key attributes include optimal distance and improving, though step up in class and unfavorable draw need consideration.

verdict.comment: There are some interesting newcomers. CAITRINHO has to deal with a wide draw but it was an encouraging start he made at Newmarket.

comments.amazingjourney: 30,000gns yearling; third foal; dam third at 1m1f in France
comments.athenasfortune: 40-1 for Newmarket debut (good) and finished some lengths behind Caitrinho
comments.bellaspiaggia: Half-sister to winners Bird Of Play (7f; RPR 78) and Mount Fairweather (Qatar 9.5f)
comments.bigharry: Third foal out of a 6f-1m winner; gelded ahead of debut and wouldn't be the obvious answer
comments.bloominglegend: 3,500euros yearling; eighth foal; half-sister to five winners; claimer-ridden on debut
comments.caitrinho: Drawn wide but would appear to be in a weaker race than when third at Newmarket
comments.catwalkchat: Expert Eye filly who cost 20,000euros as a yearling; 11th foal; half-sister to six winners
comments.excelerate: £15,000 breeze-up buy; the dam won over 5f/6f as 2yo;  still likely best watched
comments.ourcody: Weakened when push came to shove at Chepstow (5f, good) but she did go off favourite
comments.rajak: £22,000 yearling; tenth foal; brother to 7f 2yo winner Del Ray (RPR 81)
comments.saeculamation: Newmarket debut effort leaves him with plenty to find with Caitrinho
comments.squadronleader: Had no obvious excuses when a well-held fourth of six runners at Bath
comments.trouserpocket: First foal; dam 5f winner (including AW; RPR 63); others still carry greater appeal
comments.venetianlace: First foal out of a 1m-1m2f winner (Listed) and sister to 1m4f winner Swift Verdict

races.raceComment: caitrinho is marginally preferred with a score of 19.7%, holding clear edges in superior course form and more progressive over athenasfortune. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include improving, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: This can go to KITTY FURNIVAL (nap), who ran a big race in defeat behind a next-time-out winner on her seasonal debut.

comments.almudena: Dual turf winner last summer (1m6f/2m) and open to further improvement this year
comments.artisandancer: Placed in last month's Chester Plate and is very well suited by Polytrack; considered
comments.carlton: Very very suited by this C&D but usually contests much easier races than this
comments.environmentamigo: Scored by 7l when upped to 2m in September; 9lb higher now and resumes in much deeper race
comments.jackmcnamara: Very lightly raced 5yo; flopped on handicap debut but could still have potential
comments.kittyfurnival: Clear second with a next-time-out winner on seasonal debut and only 1lb higher here
comments.merrijig: C&D winner when fresh last spring but returns from latest layoff on a tough mark
comments.roadtowembley: Last month's close second came in a very tactical race but he remains on a workable mark
comments.surreyfire: Beaten favourite in three handicaps since last summer's novice win; has a point to prove
comments.tailorman: Placed off today's mark on turf this spring but others appeal more
comments.tipsytiger: Ended last season in good form on slow turf but faces a different test on reappearance
comments.trouville: Well beaten in two of his three handicaps last year but remains lightly raced; AW debut
comments.wahraan: Down the field on both outings this year, and his very slow starts make him a risky option

races.raceComment: roadtowembley is marginally preferred with a score of 55.6%. Placed in 2 of last 6 starts, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Competitive. THUNDER BLUE is tactically versatile and he returns to the AW after quite possibly needing the race at Chester.

comments.benacre: Only fifth at Newcastle after a 6lb rise and looks held by Grand Karat
comments.documenting: Exposed 12yo but an encouraging comeback run and that could have put him spot on for this
comments.fantasymaster: In form last backend and ran well on his return; however, all his form is at 5f or 6f
comments.grandkarat: Has won two of his five races since gelded and latest effort was highly encouraging
comments.habrdi: Respectable effort at Kempton last time without suggesting he's a good thing any time soon
comments.nibrasangel: Fared best of the hold-up horses when fourth over Kempton's 7f on stable debut
comments.noodlemission: Below par in the Victoria Cup and will do well to rebound here from stall 15
comments.palmarbay: Looks as good on the AW; well drawn to get prominent position and should give his running
comments.physique: Bang there in two of his three races for this yard and conceded only late on at Newmarket
comments.pressureson: Capable off this mark and did a lot of early running before weakening last time at Kempton
comments.probe: Beaten favourite at Thirsk but he's running well and is 2-4 on the AW
comments.sheriffscourt: French winner; 0-2 for this yard but 7f promises to suit on handicap debut
comments.signcastlecity: Finished strongly for second last week at Beverley but he's in deeper this time
comments.silversamurai: Although it was a good run at Kempton (7f) last time, this has the look of a stronger race
comments.tennesseegold: Personal best in December but off since; raised 7lb and drawn wide here
comments.thunderblue: Did well last year; smacked of a horse who would come on for the run at Chester

races.raceComment: documenting is marginally preferred with a score of 55.5%, holding clear edges in better ratings and better suited by conditions and stronger recent form over pressureson. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 7 wins from 29 starts in similar conditions. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Although still a maiden, GONE IN SIXTY could easily have put that right last time at Bangor had the race panned out more favourably.

comments.annienail: Perhaps dodgy form when winning over fences here; remote when third last time
comments.anothermystery: Well handicapped should the new blinkers (replacing cheekpieces) have some impact
comments.bahtiyar: Continues to fall in the weights but easy to have reservations about this 24-race maiden
comments.fastdeal: Only one win in 59 starts and that was over fences at huge odds in April last year
comments.goneinsixty: Back from an absence when close up at Bangor and suffered some interference
comments.merseystreet: Course winner; 3m2f looked too far last time; cheekpieces are added
comments.runawaytrain: He was tailed off when raised to 2m4f at Southwell (good) only recently

races.raceComment: annienail is confidently preferred with a score of 57.5%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form and superior course form and more reliable profile over goneinsixty. Won 1 of last 6 starts.
